arguments.topic: generalist cell segmentation microscopy deep learning

rows.title: Cellpose: a generalist algorithm for cellular segmentation
rows.method: Cellpose: generalist deep learning segmentation with a 3D extension that reuses the 2D model
rows.summary: Introduces a generalist model trained on over 70,000 segmented objects that segments diverse cellular images without retraining or parameter adjustment and extends to 3D without 3D-labeled data.

rows.title: A deep learning-based algorithm for 2-D cell segmentation in microscopy images.
rows.method: Deep learning prediction of cell and nuclear locations combined with thresholding and watershed segmentation
rows.modality: Single-channel 2D light microscopy images with whole-cell staining
rows.summary: Segments whole cells across varied markers and magnifications using a single staining channel without a separate nuclear stain.

rows.title: Scellseg: A style-aware deep learning tool for adaptive cell instance segmentation by contrastive fine-tuning.
rows.method: Scellseg: style-aware pretrained model with contrastive fine-tuning using unlabeled data
rows.modality: Microscopy images of organelles, cells, and organisms
rows.summary: Introduces an adaptive instance segmentation pipeline with strong transferability whose fine-tuning performance plateaus after approximately eight images.

rows.title: DetecDiv, a generalist deep-learning platform for automated cell division tracking and survival analysis.
rows.method: DetecDiv: deep learning-based division tracking, time-series classification, and semantic segmentation
rows.modality: Time-lapse microscopy of yeast in microfluidic traps
rows.summary: Combines microfluidic imaging and deep learning to automate single-cell division tracking, replicative lifespan reconstruction, and stress-response survival analysis.

rows.title: DeepSCEM: A User-Friendly Solution for Deep Learning-Based Image Segmentation in Cellular Electron Microscopy.
rows.method: DeepSCEM: convolutional neural network-based image segmentation
rows.summary: Provides a user-friendly tool for generating and training deep learning models for organelle segmentation in cellular electron microscopy.

rows.title: Artificial Intelligence for Organelle Segmentation in Live-Cell Imaging.
rows.method: Review of segmentation approaches, including deep learning, label-efficient strategies, synthetic data, and physics-guided modeling
rows.summary: Reviews organelle segmentation methods and strategies to improve generalization, reduce annotation requirements, and address 3D and multi-organelle imaging.

rows.title: Leveraging multimodal microscopy to optimize deep learning models for cell segmentation.
rows.method: Deep learning segmentation trained on channel-sampled subimage stacks from hyper-labeled images
rows.modality: Multimodal microscopy combining fluorescence and label-free brightfield images
rows.summary: Uses identical cells imaged across multiple channels to compare labeling strategies and train segmentation models that accommodate varied labeling conditions.

rows.title: Cellpose as a reliable method for single-cell segmentation of autofluorescence microscopy images.
rows.method: Cellpose autofluorescence-trained model (ATM) trained with manually segmented nuclear masks
rows.modality: Multiphoton NAD(P)H autofluorescence intensity imaging with co-registered NAD(P)H and FAD FLIM in 2D and 3D cultures
rows.dataset: Private cohort: PANC-1 cells and patient-derived cancer organoids from 9 patients
rows.metric_values: R² > 0.9 for ATM versus manual mask-derived ORR, mean NAD(P)H lifetime, and mean FAD lifetime; repeated-mask Dice reproducibility comparison p < 0.0001 (Dice values not stated)
rows.summary: Validates an autofluorescence-trained Cellpose model that improves segmentation reproducibility while preserving functional measurements and treatment effects in cells and cancer organoids.

rows.title: Automatic improvement of deep learning-based cell segmentation in time-lapse microscopy by neural architecture search.
rows.method: Neural architecture search over non-repeatable microarchitectures with a task-specific search space incorporating convolutional LSTM
rows.summary: Automatically searches segmentation architectures that exploit temporal information and achieve consistently competitive performance across ten Cell Tracking Challenge datasets.

rows.title: Instance segmentation of mitochondria in electron microscopy images with a generalist deep learning model trained on a diverse dataset
rows.method: MitoNet: generalist deep learning model for mitochondrial instance segmentation
rows.summary: Introduces MitoNet trained using a heterogeneous resource of approximately 1.5 million EM images and 135,000 mitochondrial annotations, alongside tools for inference, visualization, and proofreading.
